I missed an important deadline at work. What should I do?

Missing an important deadline can feel stressful. It is understandable to feel worried about the consequences. Give yourself a moment to regroup, then explain the situation to your manager and discuss a realistic recovery plan.

Receiving criticism on something you worked hard on can be discouraging. Your effort still matters, even when the result needs improvement. Take time to understand the feedback and decide which changes would be most helpful.

Arguments with close friends can be emotionally difficult. It makes sense that you want to repair the relationship. Consider giving both of you some time to settle down before reaching out for an honest conversation.
